description: Wave 4 — August 2026 research scope manifest. 20 entries: ROSE (7), SKYE (7), ELITE (6). External research conducted in EP-CAT-P18C (2026-08-25); Founder decisions resolved in EP-CAT-P18C-R1 (2026-08-26). 20 entries READY. Episode classified P18C_R1_PASS_WAVE4_20_OF_20_EVIDENCE_LOCKED. OUD_GAP_PROVEN_HIGH: Maison Crivelli Oud Cadenza Agarwood (Oud) confirmed from Fragrantica and Harrods (HIGH sources). ASSORTMENT_GAP_MISMATCH_INFORMATIONAL: Creed Delphinus Oriental Floral — Founder confirmed RETAIN. Jo Malone Beach Blossom and Escada Cherry in the Air: Founder confirmed RETAIN. Gucci Flora: Founder confirmed Option B — Flora Gorgeous Gardenia EDP 2021.

governance.admissibilityNote: LLM general knowledge is NOT admissible as a governed source. All claims must be traceable to a named external source. Fragrantica returns 403 on direct WebFetch; Fragrantica evidence comes from WebSearch snippets — classified HIGH rather than AUTHORITATIVE. Official brand pages accessed via WebSearch snippet or direct WebFetch are classified AUTHORITATIVE. Jo Malone London fragrances: notes presented as unordered bouquet (not top/heart/base pyramid) — recorded in heartNotes[] only, per Wave 2/Wave 3 governance precedent.
governance.schemaNote: This file follows the ResearchSourceEntry schema (Wave 3 precedent) with Wave 4 notes: evidenceStatus, researchRequired, researchNotes, proposedSlug, concentration. Jo Malone London fragrances: notes presented as unordered bouquet — record in heartNotes[] only.
governance.noteStructureNote: Jo Malone London fragrances: notes presented as unordered bouquet (not top/heart/base pyramid) — record in heartNotes[] only, per Wave 2/Wave 3 governance precedent.

evidenceStatusKey.READY: Research complete. Canonical identity, notes, and governed evidence fields are populated. Ready for factory staging.
evidenceStatusKey.FOUNDER_DECISION_REQUIRED: Research conducted but governance gap requires Founder confirmation before proceeding. See sourceNotes for the specific decision required.
evidenceStatusKey.BRAND_NARRATIVE_ONLY: Founder decision received. Brand deliberately withholds official notes. Factory generation proceeds using brand narrative only.
evidenceStatusKey.BLOCKED: Research cannot proceed due to unresolvable conflict or missing prerequisite.

specialGovernanceFlags.OUD_GAP_STATUS: OUD_GAP_PROVEN_HIGH — Agarwood (Oud) confirmed in heart notes of Maison Crivelli Oud Cadenza per Fragrantica (HIGH, reference database) and Harrods (HIGH, authorized retailer). No official Maison Crivelli brand page directly accessed. R1 tier audit: previous AUTHORITATIVE classification corrected to HIGH per source tier governance. Oriental Woody family confirmed. Oud-family classification approved for P18D staging.
specialGovernanceFlags.FAMILY_GAP_MISMATCH_CREED_DELPHINUS: ASSORTMENT_GAP_MISMATCH_INFORMATIONAL — Founder confirmed RETAIN (EP-CAT-P18C-R1 2026-08-26). Creed Delphinus is Oriental Floral (Fragrantica confirmed), not Aquatic. P18A targeted Aquatic/Fresh gap in Elite — that gap remains unfilled by Wave 4. Creed Delphinus accepted as a quality Oriental Floral Elite addition. Gap mismatch is advisory only — does not block P18D staging.
specialGovernanceFlags.JO_MALONE_LIMITED_EDITION: FOUNDER_CONFIRMED_RETAIN (EP-CAT-P18C-R1 2026-08-26). Supplier lists Beach Blossom as SUPPLIER_LISTED — identical availability status to all other Wave 4 records. Fragrantica 'Limited Edition' tag is an external catalogue classification that does not prevent supplier sourcing. Availability risk noted; Beach Blossom proceeds to P18D staging.
specialGovernanceFlags.ESCADA_LIMITED_EDITION: FOUNDER_CONFIRMED_RETAIN (EP-CAT-P18C-R1 2026-08-26). Supplier name 'Escada Cherry In The Air' specifically identifies the 2013 edition — this product name is unique to the 2013 release in the Escada annual summer series. Supplier evidence locks the 2013 identity. Cherry in the Air proceeds to P18D staging.
specialGovernanceFlags.NARCISO_BLUE_NOIR_SPELLING: Supplier uses English 'Blue Noir'; canonical Narciso Rodriguez product name is French 'Bleu Noir' (for Him Bleu Noir). Wave-4-catalogue.ts subtitle currently reads 'Inspired by Narciso Rodriguez Blue Noir' — correct spelling 'Bleu Noir' required in subtitle before promotion. Intake title 'Blue Noir Inspired' uses English per slug derivation convention; subtitle correction needed in P18D staging.
specialGovernanceFlags.GUCCI_FLORA_IDENTITY: FOUNDER_CONFIRMED_OPTION_B (EP-CAT-P18C-R1 2026-08-26). Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau de Parfum (2021) confirmed as canonical identity. Notes from Fragrantica (HIGH): top Pear Blossom/Red Berries/Italian Mandarin, heart Gardenia/Jasmine/Frangipani, base Brown Sugar/Patchouli. Perfumer: Honorine Blanc. Fragrance Foundation Women's Prestige award 2022. Subtitle correction required in wave-4-catalogue.ts: 'Inspired by Gucci Flora' → 'Inspired by Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia'.

catalogueSubtitleCorrections: MEN-151-Blue Noir by Narciso Rodriquez: wave-4-catalogue.ts subtitle must be updated from 'Inspired by Narciso Rodriguez Blue Noir' to 'Inspired by Narciso Rodriguez for Him Bleu Noir' (canonical French name) before P18D staging.

LADIES-127-Gucci Flora: wave-4-catalogue.ts subtitle must be updated from 'Inspired by Gucci Flora' to 'Inspired by Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia' before P18D staging. Founder confirmed Option B (Flora Gorgeous Gardenia EDP 2021) in EP-CAT-P18C-R1.

entries.researchNotes: Identity confirmed: Creed Delphinus, 2024 EDP, unisex Oriental Floral. FAMILY_GAP_MISMATCH: P18A targeted Aquatic/Fresh gap but fragranceFamily is Oriental Floral — warm, spiced, with Almond/Orris/Vanilla/Leather. This is NOT an aquatic fragrance. Founder decision required on gap strategy. Notes: Fragrantica (HIGH). No perfumer name found.
entries.sourceNotes: Notes researched EP-CAT-P18C from Fragrantica search snippet (HIGH). Official Creed site returns 403. Family confirmed Oriental Floral (not Aquatic). P18A intended this to fill Aquatic/Fresh Elite gap — evidence contradicts that classification. Founder decision required: (A) retain as quality Elite addition (gap mismatch accepted), or (B) replace with evidence-confirmed Aquatic candidate. Identity distinct from all five native Creed records confirmed. Part of 'The Oriental Universe' collection.
conflicts: ASSORTMENT_GAP_MISMATCH_INFORMATIONAL: P18A targeted Aquatic/Fresh Elite gap but Creed Delphinus is Oriental Floral. Founder confirmed RETAIN (EP-CAT-P18C-R1 2026-08-26). Advisory only.

entries._sourceKey: UNISEX-7-Aqua Allegoria Rosa Verde by Guerlain
entries.supplierName: Aqua Allegoria Rosa Verde by Guerlain
entries.researchNotes: Identity confirmed: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Rosa Verde, 2025 EDT, unisex. Fills Citrus/Fresh Elite gap. Concentration is EDT (not EDP). Notes from Fragrantica (HIGH).
entries.sourceNotes: Notes and perfumer from Fragrantica (HIGH). Confirmed by parfumo.com and perfumestars.com. Concentration is EDT. Available 75ml/125ml. Composed of more than 90% naturally-derived ingredients; refillable bottle. Nordstrom and Macy's list as official retailers. Distinct from all native Guerlain records confirmed.

entries.researchNotes: Identity confirmed: Matière Première Vanilla Powder, 2023. Two concentrations exist: EDP and Extrait de Parfum. Notes below are EDP version. Fills Powdery/Vanilla Elite gap.
entries.sourceNotes: Notes and perfumer from Fragrantica (HIGH). Aedes.com (authorised retailer) lists EDP and Extrait versions. Extrait version has different composition (Palo Santo, Coconut Powder top; Vanilla Absolute heart; Helvetolide musk, Tonka Bean base). EDP selected as canonical — more widely available. Niche French house, single-ingredient philosophy (Madagascar Vanilla). Distinct from all native Matiere Premiere records (none present).

entries.researchNotes: Identity confirmed: Jo Malone London Beach Blossom Cologne, 2025. UNORDERED_GOVERNED_NOTES — Jo Malone presents flat bouquet per established governance (Wave 2/Wave 3 precedent). Notes placed in heartNotes[] only. GOVERNANCE FLAG: Fragrantica classifies as 'Limited Edition'. If permanent catalogue availability cannot be confirmed, Founder decision recommended before promotion.
entries.sourceNotes: UNORDERED_GOVERNED_NOTES applied — Jo Malone presents as flat bouquet; all four notes placed in heartNotes[] per Wave 2/3 governance precedent. Official notes per Fragrantica (HIGH): Lime, Mint, Coconut Water, Tonka Bean. Jo Malone official URL (jomalone.com/product/25946/132420/) confirmed but returned 403 on WebFetch — product existence verified via Kohl's, Nordstrom, Sephora, Macy's official retailer listings. Fragrantica classifies as 'Limited Edition'. Jo Malone does not disclose perfumer. Brand narrative: 'A summer escape to the Seychelles — rare coco de mer. Refreshing twist of coconut water on the breeze, lime and mint, wrapped in tonka bean.'
conflicts: Fragrantica classifies as 'Limited Edition' — Founder confirmed RETAIN (EP-CAT-P18C-R1 2026-08-26). Advisory only.

entries.researchNotes: Identity confirmed: Calvin Klein CK One, 1994 EDT, the original unisex fragrance. Notes from Fragrantica (HIGH), corroborated by Basenotes (HIGH). Fills Fresh/Clean unisex gap.
entries.sourceNotes: Notes from Fragrantica (HIGH). Basenotes entry corroborates (HIGH). CaFleureBon historical review confirms 1994 launch and perfumers. Iconic first openly-marketed unisex fragrance. Produced under license by Coty Inc. Distinct from all native Calvin Klein records confirmed.

entries.researchNotes: Identity confirmed: Maison Crivelli Oud Cadenza, 2024 Extrait de Parfum. OUD_GAP_PROVEN_AUTHORITATIVE: Agarwood (Oud) explicitly listed in heart notes from Fragrantica (HIGH) and confirmed by Harrods (major retailer, near-authoritative). Oriental Woody family. Fills Oud-primary Elite gap. Concentration is Extrait de Parfum (not standard EDP).
entries.sourceNotes: Notes and perfumer from Fragrantica (HIGH) and Harrods product listing (maison-crivelli-x-jordi-fernandez-oud-cadenza-extrait-de-parfum, near-AUTHORITATIVE). OUD GATE RESOLVED: Agarwood (Oud) is explicitly confirmed in heart notes — not merely a name association. fragranceFamily Oriental Woody confirmed across multiple sources. Part of the 'Olfactory Escapes' line. Concentration Extrait de Parfum (not EDP). Distinct from all native Maison Crivelli records (none present).

entries.researchNotes: Identity confirmed: Davidoff Cool Water, 1988 EDT, men's. Foundational aquatic fragrance. Fills Aquatic/Fresh Skye gap.
entries.sourceNotes: Notes and perfumer from Fragrantica (HIGH). Wikipedia entry corroborates (HIGH). Distinct from all native Davidoff records. Produced under license by Coty Inc. Together with 'New West' by Aramis (1988), credited with initiating the aquatic fragrance trend.

entries.researchNotes: Identity confirmed: Versace Dylan Blue (official: Versace Pour Homme Dylan Blue), 2016 EDT, men's. Primary concentration is EDT; EDP and Parfum variants also exist. Fills Aquatic/Citrus Skye gap. Distinct from R4 (Dylan Blue Pour Femme, LADIES-275).
entries.sourceNotes: Official Versace product URL confirmed: versace.com/us/en/men/accessories/fragrances-body-care/dylan-blue-pour-homme/dylan-blue-pour-homme-edt-100-ml-blue/ (product exists). Notes from Fragrantica (HIGH). Vivir review corroborates. EDT is original concentration. EDP and Parfum variants exist with different notes. Distinct from Dylan Blue Pour Femme (LADIES-275) which is a 2017 EDP with entirely different composition.

entries.researchNotes: Identity confirmed: Ralph Lauren Polo Blue EDT (2003), men's. Also EDP (2016) and Parfum (2022) variants. Notes below are EDT as original/canonical concentration. Official ralphlaurenfragrances.com URL confirmed.
entries.sourceNotes: Official Ralph Lauren fragrance site URL confirmed: ralphlaurenfragrances.com/en_US/men/polo-blue/. Notes from Fragrantica (HIGH). EDT (2003, Carlos Benaim/Christophe Laudamiel) is the original. EDP (2016) has slightly different notes (bergamot, cardamom, sea notes/orris/basil/clary sage/vetiver/suede). EDT used as canonical. Distinct from all native Ralph Lauren records confirmed.

entries.researchNotes: P18B identity verification flag RESOLVED. Prada Paradigme is a CONFIRMED, distinct product — NOT a confusion with Paradoxe (women's). Paradigme is a men's EDP, launched 2025. Inverted fragrance pyramid structure. Official Prada site URL confirmed (prada-beauty.com and prada.com).
entries.perfumer: Marie Salamagne, Bruno Jovanovic, Nicolas Bonneville
entries.sourceNotes: Official Prada URL confirmed: prada-beauty.com/fragrance/paradigme/paradigme-eau-de-parfum/MPL01826.html (returned 403 on WebFetch but URL existence confirmed via WebSearch). Official prada.com URL also confirmed: prada.com/us/en/pradasphere/fragrances/paradigme.html. Notes from Fragrantica (HIGH), T3 review (corroborated). Inverted pyramid: 'airy musk top' → bergamot as heartward note → benzoin/resin/wood base gives warmth. Counterpart to Prada Paradoxe (women's). Bottle inspired by Prada Triangle logo.

entries.researchNotes: Identity confirmed: Montblanc Legend Blue, 2024 EDP, men's. Distinct from montblanc-legend-inspired (original Legend 2011, Aromatic Fougère — already native). Legend Blue is a 2024 EDP with Woody Aromatic character. Official Montblanc URL confirmed.
entries.sourceNotes: Official Montblanc URL confirmed: montblanc.com/en-us/eau-de-parfum_cod1647597336804437.html (product exists). Notes from Fragrantica (HIGH). Brand emphasises spearmint freshness, woody cedarwood, and ambroxan sensuality. Distinct from native montblanc-legend-inspired (2011, Aromatic Fougère, notes: Lavender/Bergamot/Geranium/Vetiver) — Legend Blue has different concentration (EDP), year (2024), and family (Woody Aromatic vs. Aromatic Fougère). Perfumer not disclosed publicly.

entries.researchNotes: Identity confirmed: Narciso Rodriguez for Him Bleu Noir EDP (2018). SPELLING CORRECTION: supplier uses English 'Blue Noir'; canonical brand name is French 'Bleu Noir'. Multiple concentrations: EDT (2015), EDP (2018), Parfum (2022). EDP (2018) selected as canonical — most widely available mid-concentration. CATALOGUE FIX REQUIRED: wave-4-catalogue.ts subtitle must be updated from 'Inspired by Narciso Rodriguez Blue Noir' to 'Inspired by Narciso Rodriguez for Him Bleu Noir' before staging.
entries.sourceNotes: Official Narciso Rodriguez URL confirmed: narcisorodriguezparfums.com/en/narciso-rodriguez-for-him-bleu-noir/for-him-bleu-noir-eau-de-parfum.html. Notes from Fragrantica EDP entry (HIGH) and David Jones retailer listing. Supplier spells brand 'Rodriquez' (typo); canonical brand is 'Narciso Rodriguez'. Supplier uses English 'Blue Noir'; canonical product name uses French 'Bleu Noir'. EDT (2015) has different notes: Bergamot, Black Pepper top; Blue Cedar, Black Ebony heart; Vetiver, Amber base. EDP (2018) selected as governing concentration. Parfum (2022) also exists.
entries.nameIssueExplanation: Supplier uses English 'Blue Noir'; canonical Narciso Rodriguez product name is French 'Bleu Noir' (for Him Bleu Noir). Wave-4-catalogue.ts subtitle must be corrected before staging.

entries.researchNotes: Identity confirmed: Bvlgari AQVA Marine Pour Homme, 2008 EDT. Supplier spells brand 'Bulgari'; canonical is 'Bvlgari'. Fills Aquatic/Marine Skye gap. Distinct from bvlgari-aqua-inspired (original Aqva) and aqva-amara-inspired (Aqva Amara flanker).
entries.sourceNotes: Notes and perfumer from Fragrantica (HIGH). Confirmed by multiple retailer listings. Supplier spells 'Bulgari'; canonical is 'Bvlgari'. Wave-4-catalogue.ts subtitle correctly uses 'Bvlgari AQVA Marine Pour Homme'. Distinct from bvlgari-aqua-inspired (original 2005 Aqva) and aqva-amara-inspired (2014 flanker) already in native MKC.
entries.nameIssueExplanation: Supplier uses 'Bulgari'; canonical brand spelling is 'Bvlgari'. Wave-4-catalogue.ts title/subtitle already corrected to 'Bvlgari' — no further action required.

entries.researchNotes: Identity confirmed: DKNY Be Delicious (women's), 2004. Canonical product name is 'DKNY Be Delicious' — 'Green' in supplier entry refers to the iconic green apple bottle, distinguishing it from flankers (Fresh Blossom, Gold, Red, etc.). EDP is primary retail concentration. Fills Citrus/Fresh/Fruity Rose gap.
entries.sourceNotes: Notes and perfumer from Fragrantica (HIGH). Both EDT and EDP concentrations available. EDP selected as canonical. '(Green)' in supplier name is a non-official descriptor for the green apple bottle, to distinguish from other DKNY Be Delicious variants (GOLD, RED, FRESH BLOSSOM). Intake title 'DKNY Be Delicious Green Inspired' uses the supplier descriptor to prevent ambiguity — acceptable as no canonical product is named 'Be Delicious Green'. Distinct from all native DKNY records confirmed (none present).
entries.nameIssueExplanation: '(Green)' in supplier name is not part of the official product name. It is a colloquial descriptor for the original women's Be Delicious (green apple bottle), differentiating it from flankers. Canonical product name is 'DKNY Be Delicious'.

entries.researchNotes: Identity confirmed: Clinique Happy (women's), 1997. EDP. Clinique's bestselling women's fragrance. FiFi Award 1998. Fills Citrus/Fresh Rose gap.
entries.sourceNotes: Notes and perfumers from Fragrantica (HIGH). clinique.com URL confirmed (product exists). FiFi Award winner 1998. Clinique Happy for Men exists separately (supplier MEN-44); LADIES version confirmed as canonical for Rose collection. Distinct from all native Clinique records confirmed.

entries.researchNotes: Identity confirmed: Narciso Rodriguez Pure Musc for Her, 2019 EDP. DISTINCTNESS PROVEN (Phase 7): distinct from narciso-rodriguez-for-her-inspired (2003, Floral Musk, notes: Rose/Peach top, Musk/Amber heart, Patchouli/Sandalwood base) and narciso-rouge-inspired (2019, Powdery Floral, notes: Iris/Bulgarian Rose top, Musk/Tuberose/Orange Blossom heart). Pure Musc has unique minimal 4-note composition with Musk as lead top note and Cashmeran base — a distinct olfactive experience.
entries.sourceNotes: Official Narciso Rodriguez URL confirmed: narcisorodriguezparfums.com/en/narciso-rodriguez-for-her-pure-musc/for-her-PURE-MUSC.html. Notes and perfumer from Fragrantica (HIGH), Amazon listing corroborates. 4-note composition is intentional — brand positions it as 'the purest, most essential version of the for her signature.' Cashmeran base provides warmth without the sweetness of vanilla. DISTINCTNESS from native Narciso records: identity distinct (different 2019 product from Narciso Rouge which is also 2019), composition distinct (4 vs. 6+ notes, musk as top, cashmeran not present in others), family distinct (Floral Woody Musk adds Woody dimension). Concierge differentiation: Pure Musc serves the 'clean musc' guest profile; for-her serves 'warm floral musk'; rouge serves 'powdery floral'.

entries.researchNotes: Identity confirmed: Versace Pour Femme Dylan Blue (official Versace name), 2017 EDP, women's. LADIES supplier category (LADIES-275) is the governing evidence that distinguishes this from MEN-139 (Dylan Blue EDT). Identity confirmed from versace.com official URL. Fills Aquatic/Fresh Rose gap.
entries.sourceNotes: Official Versace URL confirmed: versace.com/us/en/dylan-blue-pour-femme-edp-50-ml/R702030-R050MLS.html (product page exists). Notes from Fragrantica (HIGH). Perfumer Calice Becker from Fragrantica. Official Versace product name is 'Versace Pour Femme Dylan Blue'. Intake slug 'dylan-blue-pour-femme-inspired' correctly differentiates from men's 'dylan-blue-inspired'. Contains experimental raw materials: Pétalia (rose/peony molecule), Rosyfolia, Shisolia. Donatella Versace: 'a tribute to femininity.'

entries.researchNotes: Identity confirmed: Escada Cherry in the Air, 2013 EDT, women's. Part of Escada's annual limited-edition summer series (running since 1993). GOVERNANCE FLAG: Each year's Escada summer fragrance is a different product. Founder should confirm supplier's current stock refers to the 2013 original. Fills Fruity/Fresh Rose gap.
entries.sourceNotes: Notes from Fragrantica (HIGH). Confirmed by multiple retailer listings (LaBellePerfumes, ForeverLux, PerfumeAndrea). EDT concentration confirmed across all sources. 'Daim' = suede accord (French). Escada summer series note: different product each year since 1993. Supplier should confirm current stock is the 2013 Cherry in the Air and not a different year's release. Distinct from all native Escada records confirmed.
conflicts: Part of annual limited-edition summer series — Founder confirmed RETAIN (EP-CAT-P18C-R1 2026-08-26). Supplier name 'Escada Cherry In The Air' locks 2013 edition identity. Advisory only.

entries.researchNotes: Identity confirmed: Chloé Eau de Parfum (2008). Supplier 'Chloe Original' refers to the original Chloé EDP (2008), distinguishing it from subsequent flankers (Chloé Eau de Toilette 2009, Chloé Rose, Chloé Nomade, etc.). Fills Classic Luxury Floral Rose position.
entries.sourceNotes: Notes and perfumers from Fragrantica (HIGH). Basenotes entry corroborates. chloe.com product URL confirmed (returned 403). Sephora lists as 'Chloé Eau de Parfum'. Supplier 'Chloe Original' = Chloé EDP 2008 (the founding fragrance, pre-flankers). Title in Wave 4 intake strips diacritic per slug convention ('Chloe Original Inspired'); subtitle preserves diacritic ('Inspired by Chloé Original') per Wave 3 precedent. IDENTITY_CONFIRMED.
entries.nameIssueExplanation: Supplier uses 'Chloe Original' (no diacritic); canonical brand is 'Chloé'. Title strips diacritic for slug; subtitle preserves diacritic per Wave 3 governance precedent. Already handled in wave-4-catalogue.ts — no further action required.

entries.founderDecision: FOUNDER_CONFIRMED_OPTION_B: Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau de Parfum (2021). Authorized by Founder EP-CAT-P18C-R1 2026-08-26.
entries.researchNotes: IDENTITY_RESOLVED. Founder confirmed Option B: Flora Gorgeous Gardenia EDP (2021). Supplier 'Gucci Flora' resolved to current flagship. Notes researched from Fragrantica (HIGH) confirmed in EP-CAT-P18C-R1. Fragrance Foundation Women's Prestige award 2022. Catalogue subtitle correction required before P18D staging: 'Inspired by Gucci Flora' → 'Inspired by Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia'.
entries.sourceNotes: Notes from Fragrantica (HIGH) — EP-CAT-P18C-R1 research. Fragrantica page confirmed: fragrantica.com/perfume/Gucci/Flora-Gorgeous-Gardenia-68578.html. Top: Pear Blossom, Red Berries, Italian Mandarin. Heart: Gardenia, Jasmine, Frangipani. Base: Brown Sugar, Patchouli. Perfumer: Honorine Blanc. Vivir review corroborates. Family: Floral Fruity. Concentration: EDP. Gender: female. Fragrance Foundation Women's Prestige award 2022. Major Miley Cyrus campaign launch. Available at Nordstrom, Sephora, and Gucci official channels. Option A (Flora by Gucci EDT 2009) considered and rejected — reportedly discontinued, option not pursued after Founder confirmed Option B.
entries.nameIssueExplanation: Supplier 'Gucci Flora' resolved to canonical 'Flora Gorgeous Gardenia'. wave-4-catalogue.ts subtitle must be corrected from 'Inspired by Gucci Flora' to 'Inspired by Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia' before P18D staging.
